capabilities: Compare proposed changes with current state
extras: Requires local LLM setup for chat functionality. Not yet covering appearance/CSS or writing app settings. Ships with a full German translation.
problem: Manually editing configuration JSON files is error-prone and lacks a safe, reversible workflow.

relations.evidence: Lessons learned from Config Sync (MIT, xooooooooox/obsidian-config-sync) informed several edge cases.
With the LLM Endpoint Manager installed: choose an endpoint or let the first reachable one win.

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible local server (LM Studio, Ollama, MLX)

summary: A tool that allows users to modify Obsidian app and plugin settings using reviewed profiles or a local LLM chat, ensuring safety and reversibility.
